author: Forbes
description:
The 2026 New York Auto Show brought the excitement, where 2,000-horsepower concept cars and $27,000 electric vehicles are competing for the future of the American driveway. From the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center, the focus has shifted from the frantic race for pure electrification toward a strategy of choice: a marketplace where high-performance hybrids meet "radically affordable" entry-level EVs. Leading this charge is the global debut of the Hyundai Boulder Concept, a chiseled, body-on-frame SUV that might signal the brand’s intent to challenge the Jeep Wrangler and Ford Bronco for off-road dominance by 2030.

Subaru is getting into the three-row EV game early with the 2027 Getaway, a 420-horsepower powerhouse featuring NACS-compatible charging and a family-friendly layout. Simultaneously, Chevrolet is redefining the supercar segment with the Corvette CX and CX.R concepts, delivering a staggering 2,000 horsepower through electrified powertrains.
